heading.zh-Hant: 早年、潛艦與海軍戰爭學院
heading.en: Early career, submarines and the Naval War College

body.zh-Hant: 尼米茲1905年1月30日在安納波利斯海軍官校畢業，班上114人中名列第七。他其後擔任四個接續的潛艦指揮職，成為「豬艇」（潛艦）方面的權威。1922至1923年，他在海軍戰爭學院研究假想的太平洋戰爭。1939年，他出任海軍航海局局長。
body.en: Nimitz graduated seventh in a class of 114 at Annapolis on 30 January 1905. In four consecutive submarine commands he became a leading authority on the "pigboat". In 1922–23 he studied a theoretical Pacific war at the Navy War College. In 1939 he became chief of the Bureau of Navigation.

heading.zh-Hant: 太平洋艦隊與太平洋戰區總司令
heading.en: Commander in Chief of the Pacific Fleet and Pacific Ocean Areas

body.zh-Hant: 珍珠港事件後，金梅爾被免職，尼米茲獲選接替其太平洋艦隊總司令職位，交接於1941年聖誕節在珍珠港舉行。他指揮的艦隊在珊瑚海與中途島取得勝利，他也被任命為太平洋戰區總司令。1944年12月國會晉升他為海軍五星上將。1945年9月2日，他在東京灣的密蘇里號戰艦上代表美國簽署和約。
body.en: After the Pearl Harbor attack, Kimmel was relieved and Nimitz was chosen to replace him; the change of command took place at Pearl Harbor on Christmas Day 1941. Victories followed in the Coral Sea and at Midway, and he was named commander-in-chief of Pacific Ocean Areas. In December 1944 Congress promoted him to fleet admiral. On 2 September 1945 he signed for the United States aboard the battleship Missouri in Tokyo Bay.

heading.en: Chief of Naval Operations and later years

body.zh-Hant: 1945年12月15日，尼米茲接替金上將，出任美國艦隊總司令。美國海軍官校資料把他的海軍作戰部長任期寫為1945至1947年；德州歷史協會條目說，他在兩年後卸任。他於1966年2月20日去世。
body.en: On 15 December 1945 Nimitz succeeded Admiral King; the Naval Academy page gives his term as Chief of Naval Operations as 1945–1947, and the Texas State Historical Association entry says he withdrew after two years. He died on 20 February 1966.

heading.en: Early career and the interwar years

body.zh-Hant: 馬歇爾1901年畢業於維吉尼亞軍校。第一次世界大戰期間他隨第一師赴法，因在坎蒂尼、艾斯納—馬恩河、聖米耶勒與默茲—阿爾貢各役中的參謀工作而聞名。1919至1924年他擔任潘興將軍的副官；1936至1938年，他以准將軍階指揮第五步兵旅。
body.en: Marshall graduated from the Virginia Military Institute in 1901. In the First World War he sailed to France with the First Division and became known for his staff work in the battles of Cantigny, Aisne-Marne, St. Mihiel and Meuse-Argonne. He was aide-de-camp to General Pershing in 1919–1924 and, as a brigadier general, commanded the Fifth Infantry Brigade in 1936–1938.

heading.en: Chief of Staff of the Army

body.zh-Hant: 1939年9月，羅斯福總統任命馬歇爾為陸軍參謀長，軍階為上將。1944年他成為陸軍五星上將。諾貝爾基金會的傳記稱他任參謀長至1945年，負責建設、補給並部分負責部署逾八百萬名士兵，且參加卡薩布蘭加、魁北克、開羅—德黑蘭、雅爾達與波茨坦各次會議。他於1945年11月辭去參謀長。
body.en: In September 1939 President Roosevelt named Marshall chief of staff with the rank of general. He became General of the Army in 1944. The Nobel Foundation biography says he served as chief of staff to 1945, was responsible for building, supplying and in part deploying over eight million soldiers, and took part in conferences at Casablanca, Quebec, Cairo-Teheran, Yalta and Potsdam. He resigned in November 1945.

heading.en: Special mission to China and Secretary of State

body.zh-Hant: 戰後馬歇爾以杜魯門總統代表的身分赴中國執行特別任務。1947年1月21日，他就任國務卿，任期至1949年1月20日。國務院歷史辦公室說，他在1947至1948年主導爭取國會支持對西歐的大規模援助方案，即後來的馬歇爾計畫。
body.en: After the war Marshall represented President Truman on a special mission to China. He entered on duty as Secretary of State on 21 January 1947 and served until 20 January 1949. The State Department Office of the Historian says that in 1947 and 1948 he led the effort to secure congressional support for the large aid package for Western Europe that became the Marshall Plan.

body.zh-Hant: 布拉德利1893年2月12日生於密蘇里州克拉克附近。他的父親在1908年1月31日因肺炎去世，母親隨後遷居莫伯利。1911年7月27日他收到電報，得知自己在入學考試中名列第一，並於同年8月1日前往西點軍校報到。他在班上164人中排第44名，艾森豪是同班同學之一。第一次世界大戰期間，他被派到蒙大拿州看守銅礦。
body.en: Bradley was born on 12 February 1893 near Clark, Missouri. His father died of pneumonia on 31 January 1908 and his mother then moved to Moberly. On 27 July 1911 a telegram told him he had placed first in the entrance examination, and he reported to West Point on 1 August 1911. He ranked 44th in a class of 164 and Eisenhower was a classmate. In the First World War he was sent to Montana to guard copper mines.

heading.en: Interwar service and the Infantry School

body.zh-Hant: 大戰後，布拉德利任教於大學並就讀於班寧堡與李文沃斯堡的陸軍進階學校，學習指揮與軍事組織的基本功。1941年，他被任命指揮喬治亞州班寧堡的步兵學校，在海外任職前訓練了數以千計的士兵與軍官。陸軍參謀長馬歇爾正需要能組織大量兵員的領導人，布拉德利是他找來的人之一。
body.en: After the war Bradley taught at colleges and attended advanced Army schools at Fort Benning and Fort Leavenworth, learning the fundamentals of command and military organization. In 1941 he was appointed to command the Infantry School at Fort Benning, Georgia, and trained thousands of men and officers before going overseas. Army Chief of Staff George Marshall needed leaders who could organize large numbers of men, and Bradley was one he turned to.

heading.zh-Hant: 北非、西西里與歐洲戰場
heading.en: North Africa, Sicily and the European campaign

body.zh-Hant: 1943年初，艾森豪派布拉德利去研究美軍第二軍在卡塞林隘口戰敗後的情況；第二軍再度上陣時擊退德軍，俘虜四萬人。布拉德利隨後參加了成功的西西里登陸。西西里之後，他被任命為1944年6月6日登陸日美軍的野戰指揮官。到1945年戰爭結束時，他的部隊已首先攻入德國，並控制該國大部分地區。
body.en: In early 1943 Eisenhower sent Bradley to study the situation after the American II Corps was defeated at Kasserine Pass; when the II Corps next fought it drove the Germans back and captured 40,000. Bradley then served in the successful invasion of Sicily. After Sicily he was named field commander of American soldiers on D-Day, 6 June 1944. When the war ended in May 1945 his forces had been first to invade Germany and controlled much of the country.

body.zh-Hant: 二戰結束時，杜魯門總統請布拉德利領導退伍軍人管理局，他任職至1948年，轉任陸軍參謀長。次年他成為首任參謀首長聯席會議主席。1950年國會晉升他為五星上將，1953年他以六十歲之齡退役。他於1981年4月8日因心臟衰竭去世，葬於阿靈頓國家公墓。
body.en: As the war ended President Truman asked Bradley to lead the Veterans Administration; he served until 1948, when he became Army chief of staff. The next year he became the first Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff. In 1950 Congress made him General of the Army with five stars, and he retired in 1953 at the age of sixty. He died of heart failure on 8 April 1981 and was buried at Arlington National Cemetery.

body.zh-Hant: 萊希1875年5月6日生於愛荷華州漢普頓，1897年畢業於海軍官校，被派往奧瑞岡號戰艦，並在美西戰爭期間隨該艦服役。1899年他被派往亞洲艦隊，參與鎮壓菲律賓叛亂與中國義和團。1904年返美後，他先後在巡洋艦服役、任海軍官校教官，並擔任駐尼加拉瓜美軍指揮官的參謀長。
body.en: Leahy was born in Hampton, Iowa, on 6 May 1875 and graduated from the Naval Academy in 1897. He was assigned to the battleship Oregon and served in her through the Spanish-American War. In 1899 he was sent to the Asiatic Station, where he took part in suppressing the Philippine Insurrection and the Boxer Rebellion. After returning in 1904 he served in cruisers, taught at the Naval Academy and was chief of staff to the commander of U.S. forces in Nicaragua.

heading.zh-Hant: 海軍作戰部長、總督與駐法大使
heading.en: Chief of Naval Operations, governor and ambassador to France

body.zh-Hant: 1937年1月，萊希出任海軍作戰部長，任職兩年多，期間常兼代理海軍部長。1939年8月退役後，他被任命為波多黎各總督。1940年11月29日他被任命為駐法國大使，1941年1月8日呈遞國書，1942年5月1日離開維琪。
body.en: In January 1937 Leahy became Chief of Naval Operations, serving for more than two years and frequently acting as Secretary of the Navy. After retiring in August 1939 he was appointed Governor of Puerto Rico. He was appointed Ambassador to France on 29 November 1940, presented credentials on 8 January 1941 and left Vichy on 1 May 1942.

heading.zh-Hant: 總統幕僚長與五星上將
heading.en: Presidential chief of staff and Fleet Admiral

body.zh-Hant: 回國後，萊希被召回現役，擔任羅斯福總統的副官與聯合參謀首長會議的資深成員。1944年12月，他晉升海軍五星上將。羅斯福於1945年4月去世後，他繼續留任，協助杜魯門總統。他於1949年退役，但名義上到1959年7月20日去世前仍在現役。
body.en: On returning home Leahy was recalled to Navy service as Aide to President Roosevelt and Senior Member of the Joint Chiefs of Staff. He was promoted to Fleet Admiral in December 1944. After Roosevelt died in April 1945 he continued in his posts, assisting President Truman. He retired in 1949 but technically remained on active duty until his death on 20 July 1959.
